notes: Rebel dossier for a five-year regime known from one page (the Lelang page); the Four Commanderies page does not mention it. No separate Wikipedia article was opened or found. Whether Wang Tiao held the whole commandery, took a title, or what his relation to the Goguryeo war of 28-44 on the Daemusin page was, none of the pages say. Confidence 3 holds for the years and for 'Lelang', not for the extent.
